changelog: - **A document that cannot start a run is refused everywhere, with its reason.** A document whose starting amounts the engine refuses (a Pool starting above its capacity, or below zero) showed its reason in the run bar and refused Play and Step, but Monte Carlo could still be run: it failed and said only "Run failed". After a reload the reason was gone and Play could be pressed. A Workspace saved from such a document, or changed outside the app, reopened at its saved run position: Step and Play then ran a document that cannot start, until Reset showed the reason again. The reason is now known from the moment the document opens, reloads or is reopened from a Workspace; Step, Play and Monte Carlo are refused, and the Monte Carlo dialog shows why. Such a Workspace opens its document as written, without its saved run position, and says so. A Workspace of a document that can start a run restores its run position as before.
